name: 06 · Past simple vs present perfect · Normal
description: 30 preguntas para distinguir hechos terminados con tiempo pasado de resultados, experiencias y periodos conectados con el presente.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: Yesterday, we ___ the affected workstation from the network.
questions.explanation: Yesterday es un periodo pasado y terminado; usamos past simple: isolated.
questions.translation: Ayer aislamos de la red la estación de trabajo afectada.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Current result
questions.question: We ___ the affected workstation, so it can no longer communicate with the attacker.
questions.explanation: No indicamos un momento pasado terminado y destacamos el resultado actual del aislamiento; usamos have isolated.
questions.translation: Hemos aislado la estación de trabajo afectada, así que ya no puede comunicarse con el atacante.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: The alert ___ at 02:14 this morning.
questions.explanation: At 02:14 indica un momento concreto y terminado; usamos past simple: triggered.
questions.translation: La alerta se activó esta mañana a las 02:14.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Negatives and yet
questions.question: Our monitoring tools ___ any further malicious activity since the block.
questions.explanation: Since the block conecta un punto pasado con el presente; con tools usamos haven't detected.
questions.translation: Nuestras herramientas de monitorización no han detectado más actividad maliciosa desde el bloqueo.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Questions
questions.question: ___ the customer ___ the firewall logs last night?
questions.explanation: Last night es un periodo terminado; la pregunta se forma con Did + sujeto + verbo base.
questions.translation: ¿Envió el cliente los logs del firewall anoche?

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Questions
questions.question: ___ the customer ___ the requested firewall logs yet?
questions.explanation: Yet pregunta si algo ha ocurrido hasta ahora; con customer usamos Has ... sent?
questions.translation: ¿Ha enviado ya el cliente los logs del firewall solicitados?

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: The analyst ___ the incident report on Monday.
questions.explanation: On Monday sitúa la acción en un tiempo pasado terminado; el past simple de write es wrote.
questions.translation: El analista escribió el informe del incidente el lunes.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Current result
questions.question: The analyst ___ the report and attached it to the case, so you can review it now.
questions.explanation: El informe está disponible ahora y no se menciona un momento terminado; usamos has written.
questions.translation: El analista ha escrito el informe y lo ha adjuntado al caso, así que ya podéis revisarlo.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: We ___ any malware during yesterday's scan.
questions.explanation: Yesterday's scan es un evento terminado; la negativa es didn't + verbo base: didn't find.
questions.translation: No encontramos malware durante el análisis de ayer.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Negatives and yet
questions.question: We ___ any evidence of persistence yet.
questions.explanation: Yet conecta la búsqueda con el momento actual; usamos present perfect: haven't found.
questions.translation: Todavía no hemos encontrado evidencias de persistencia.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: The incident ___ three days ago.
questions.explanation: Three days ago exige past simple; el pasado de begin es began.
questions.translation: El incidente comenzó hace tres días.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · So far and unfinished periods
questions.question: The investigation ___ two compromised accounts so far.
questions.explanation: So far significa hasta ahora y destaca el resultado acumulado; con investigation usamos has revealed.
questions.translation: La investigación ha revelado dos cuentas comprometidas hasta ahora.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: The vendor ___ the security patch in September.
questions.explanation: In September se interpreta como un periodo pasado terminado; usamos released.
questions.translation: El proveedor publicó el parche de seguridad en septiembre.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Current result
questions.question: The vendor ___ a security patch, and it is available for deployment now.
questions.explanation: La disponibilidad actual del parche es el resultado importante; usamos has released.
questions.translation: El proveedor ha publicado un parche de seguridad y ya está disponible para desplegarlo.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: We ___ forty high-priority alerts yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday es un periodo terminado; usamos past simple: reviewed.
questions.translation: Ayer revisamos cuarenta alertas de alta prioridad.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · So far and unfinished periods
questions.question: We ___ forty high-priority alerts so far today.
questions.explanation: So far today indica un periodo que continúa hasta ahora; usamos have reviewed.
questions.translation: Hoy hemos revisado hasta ahora cuarenta alertas de alta prioridad.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Client decisions and updates
questions.question: The customer ___ the containment plan during yesterday's call.
questions.explanation: During yesterday's call sitúa la decisión en un evento pasado terminado; usamos approved.
questions.translation: El cliente aprobó el plan de contención durante la llamada de ayer.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Current result
questions.question: The customer ___ the containment plan, so we can proceed now.
questions.explanation: La aprobación produce un resultado actual y no se indica cuándo ocurrió; usamos has approved.
questions.translation: El cliente ha aprobado el plan de contención, así que podemos continuar ahora.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Questions
questions.question: When ___ the forensic scan ___?
questions.explanation: When pregunta por un momento pasado concreto; usamos Did ... finish?, con el verbo en forma base.
questions.translation: ¿Cuándo terminó el análisis forense?

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Questions
questions.question: ___ you ever ___ this file hash in another incident?
questions.explanation: Ever pregunta por experiencia hasta el presente; usamos Have you ever seen...?, con el participio seen.
questions.translation: ¿Habéis visto alguna vez este hash de archivo en otro incidente?

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Since and current connection
questions.question: Since our last update, traffic levels ___ to normal.
questions.explanation: Since our last update conecta el cambio con el presente; con traffic levels usamos have returned.
questions.translation: Desde nuestra última actualización, los niveles de tráfico han vuelto a la normalidad.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: Traffic levels ___ to normal at 11:05.
questions.explanation: At 11:05 indica un momento pasado concreto; usamos past simple: returned.
questions.translation: Los niveles de tráfico volvieron a la normalidad a las 11:05.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · So far and unfinished periods
questions.question: This week, we ___ six malicious domains for the customer.
questions.explanation: This week es un periodo todavía abierto y se presenta un resultado acumulado; usamos have blocked.
questions.translation: Esta semana hemos bloqueado seis dominios maliciosos para el cliente.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: Last week, we ___ six malicious domains for the customer.
questions.explanation: Last week es un periodo terminado; usamos past simple: blocked.
questions.translation: La semana pasada bloqueamos seis dominios maliciosos para el cliente.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Finished past time
questions.question: The administrator ___ the account at 09:30.
questions.explanation: At 09:30 aporta una hora concreta de la cronología; usamos past simple: locked.
questions.translation: El administrador bloqueó la cuenta a las 09:30.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Current result
questions.question: The administrator ___ the account, so the user cannot sign in now.
questions.explanation: La consecuencia actual es que el usuario no puede acceder; sin tiempo pasado terminado usamos has locked.
questions.translation: El administrador ha bloqueado la cuenta, así que el usuario no puede iniciar sesión ahora.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Error recognition
questions.question: Choose the natural sentence with a finished past time.
options: We have detected the activity yesterday.
We have detect the activity yesterday.
We did detected the activity yesterday.
questions.explanation: Con yesterday usamos past simple: We detected. No combinamos present perfect con un tiempo pasado terminado.
questions.translation: Detectamos la actividad ayer.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Current result
questions.question: Choose the natural update when the exact time is not important and containment is complete now.
questions.explanation: Have completed presenta la contención como un resultado actual sin indicar un momento pasado terminado.
questions.translation: Hemos completado la contención.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Client decisions and updates
questions.question: During the call, the client ___ that the affected device was no longer in use.
questions.explanation: During the call sitúa la confirmación en un evento pasado terminado; usamos confirmed.
questions.translation: Durante la llamada, el cliente confirmó que el dispositivo afectado ya no se utilizaba.

questions.topic: Past simple vs present perfect · Since and current connection
questions.question: We ___ the suspicious process last night and ___ the host isolated since then.
questions.explanation: Last night exige past simple: detected. Since then conecta el estado posterior con el presente: have kept.
questions.translation: Detectamos el proceso sospechoso anoche y hemos mantenido el host aislado desde entonces.
